title: Manganese catalyzed cross-coupling of allylic alcohols and indoles: an elegant route for access to γ-hydroxyindole
content:

Efficient synthesis of a broad range of γ-hydroxyindoles was accomplished by a manganese(I) pincer complex catalyzed cross-coupling reaction between indoles and allylic alcohols.
